prompt: Please generate an image. Locked painterly style: hand-painted stylized game art, chunky readable shapes, detail painted not modelled, mid-level detail, softer muted colours with gentle saturation, epic and luminous, never grim. The palette's warm gold and cool teal are painted into the surfaces, but the light is flat, even studio light: no strong key light, no cast shadows, no rim light. Use the attached images only as reference as described: the first attachment is always the style reference for palette and brushwork; later attachments are the approved designs to keep. Game-asset reference sheet for 3D modelling, wide landscape 16:9. Plain light neutral grey background, no scene, no sky, no clouds, no floating rock, no ground plane, a soft contact shadow only. Every piece fully isolated with clear space around it, nothing overlapping, nothing touching the edge, arranged in tidy rows, each with a small neat hand-lettered label underneath. MODULAR KIT PIECES sheet: Redraw of the attached reference sheet to the current spec: keep exactly the same pieces, their order, names and sizes. Garden biome nature kit, 27 pieces, labels exactly as written in quotes, sizes as width x height. Row 1, TREES AND HEDGES: "Apple tree A" 5 x 5 m (short twisting trunk, round open canopy of clumped leaves with red apples); "Apple tree B" 5.5 x 5 m (wider, leaning trunk splitting low, flatter crown); "Windbreak poplar A" 3 x 12 m (tall narrow columnar crown of stacked olive clumps with yellow tips); "Windbreak poplar B" 3 x 13 m (fuller, blunter top); "Hedgerow, straight 4 m" 4 x 1.5 m (dense leaf mass with white and pink flowers, soft ends); "Hedgerow, corner" 2 x 1.5 m (L corner with 2 m legs). Row 2, CROP PLOTS, exactly five plots and no others, each a square 2 x 2 m plot: "Furrowed plot, 2 m" 2 x 0.5 m (brown furrows with rows of green seedlings); "Wheat, 2 m plot" 2 x 1 m (dense golden wheat); "Flax, 2 m plot" 2 x 1 m (slender stems with soft blue flowers); "Cabbages, 2 m plot" 2 x 0.5 m (3 x 3 pale-green cabbage heads); "Leeks, 2 m plot" 2 x 0.5 m (rows of blue-green leek fans). Row 3, BEDS AND PROPS: "Herb bed" 2 x 0.9 m (low pale dry-stone box with lavender, sage, rosemary); "Flowering bed" 2 x 1.2 m (same stone box with daisies and pink hollyhocks); "Post-and-rail fence, 2 m" 2 x 1 m (thick split-wood posts, two thick rails); "Scarecrow" 1.5 x 2.2 m (pole and crossbar, straw hat, cream shirt, red sash); "Haystack" 3 x 2.5 m (round conical golden straw stack); "Stone well" 2.2 x 3 m (round dry-stone wall, two timber posts, small shingled roof, thick rope and bucket). Row 4, GROUND COVER: "Meadow strip grass tuft" 0.8 x 0.7 m; "Clover patch" 0.5 x 0.2 m; "Wildflower clump" 0.6 x 0.5 m. Row 5, WALLS AND ISLE EDGE: "Dry-stone wall, straight 2 m" 2 x 1 m (four courses of pale limestone with warm clay gaps, moss on top, one 2 m piece); "Dry-stone wall, corner" 2 x 1 m (L corner, 2 m legs); "Terrace wall, stepped 4 m" 4 x 2 m (retaining wall stepping from 2 m to 1 m high halfway, turf cap); "Dry-stone wall, broken 2 m" 2 x 1 m (collapsed rubble of loose blocks); "Clay bank" 2.5 x 1.5 m (crumbling warm orange clay mound with turf and daisies on top); "Lip / terrace edge" 8 x 2.5 m (isle edge segment: limestone wall courses with turf cap, grass and ivy hanging over, flat cut ends so segments tile); "Underside (terrace)" 8 x 12 m (tapering limestone and warm clay chunk, terrace wall courses stepping down at the top, orange clay layers below, hanging roots). Pale limestone, warm clay and tended greens as in the attached sheet; draw only these 27 pieces, each exactly once: one clay bank only, no harvested, autumn, frosted or winter plots even though the attached sheet shows them, no extra pieces. Show each piece as an orthographic front elevation (no perspective) with a small three-quarter view beside it, on faint module grid lines, with its name and size (for example "3 x 4 m") in the label. Thick, solid forms, no thin parts. A plain neutral 1.8 m human silhouette labelled "1.8 m" stands on the sheet for scale, with everything at true scale to it. Title at the top: "Garden nature kit".
